author: Quote.Trade
description: Official hosted MCP for Quote.Trade: market data, account/positions/risk, orders and cancels, deposits, and stablecoin withdrawals to the user's own wallet.
name: Quote.Trade MCP Adapter

tools.name: quote_trade_api_discovery
tools.title: Quote.Trade direct API discovery
tools.description: Read once to learn efficient direct REST/WebSocket use: routes, signing, streaming, cumulative depth, and client execution controls. Public guidance only; no upstream calls.

bases.description: Configured REST, WebSocket, and MCP URLs.

executionControls.description: Controls required in direct API clients.

tools.name: quote_trade_api_manifest
tools.title: Quote.Trade API/MCP manifest
tools.description: Explains that MCP is only a tool/schema adapter around the existing Quote.Trade APIs, and returns local servlet guardrail configuration.

servletOnly.description: True when this adapter is servlet-hosted only.

directApiDiscoveryUrl.description: Public GET guide for efficient direct REST/WebSocket use.

liquidityApiBase.description: Configured and validated at startup, but no MCP tool currently routes a request through it - every tool (withdraw included) calls apiBase. Reported here for operator visibility only.

ordersExposedThroughMcp.description: True when order tools are registered in tools/list.

withdrawalsExposedThroughMcp.description: True when withdraw tools are registered in tools/list.

depositsExposedThroughMcp.description: True when deposit-address tools are registered in tools/list.

liveTradingExecutable.description: Server configuration permits orders: trading enabled and a nonempty symbol allowlist. No MCP USD cap; caller credentials and backend account checks are still required.

liveWithdrawExecutable.description: Server configuration permits a supported withdrawal asset: trading enabled and USDC/USDT/XUSDC allowed. No MCP USD cap; caller withdrawal entitlement and backend balance checks are still required.

withdrawDestination.description: Always own-wallet-login-only; no toAddress is ever accepted.

maxNotionalUsd.description: Null: no MCP per-order or per-withdrawal USD notional cap.

maxNotionalMode.description: Always unlimited for MCP orders and withdrawals. Backend account controls still apply.

maxDailyNotionalUsd.description: Null: no MCP cumulative daily USD cap on orders or withdrawals.

dailyNotionalUsed.description: Compatibility field, always zero: MCP does not track a daily USD budget.

mcpHostSeesApiSecret.description: True when private tools accept X-MBX-APISECRET at this MCP host.

approvalTextRequired.description: Exact approval friction text for live orders.

withdrawApprovalTextRequired.description: Exact approval friction text for live withdraws.

approvalFrictionOnly.description: True when humanApproved/approvalText are friction only.

credentialScoping.description: Wallet login optional. Trade-only key: no withdraw. Full-access key (trade+withdraw): withdraw allowed.

walletLoginOptional.description: True: agents can trade with a web-app API key without wallet logon.

credentialMapping.description: How to map a logon/register response, or a web-app API key, onto MCP client headers.

allowedSymbols.description: Trading symbol allowlist. Empty=deny-all; *=all instruments; else explicit symbols.

allowedWithdrawAssets.description: Withdraw asset allowlist, independent of allowedSymbols. Empty=deny-all withdrawals; *=all stablecoins; else explicit assets (USDC, USDT, XUSDC).

depositAssets.description: Supported deposit asset symbols (USDC, USDT, XUSDC).

withdrawAssets.description: Supported withdraw asset symbols (stablecoins only: USDC, USDT, XUSDC).

apiSecret.description: Whether the per-request API secret is set.

outboundAuthHeaders.description: Headers sent to Quote.Trade private APIs.

mcpHostSeesApiSecret.description: True: this MCP host receives the raw API secret to compute the HMAC signature.

trustWarning.description: What possession of the API secret grants this MCP host.

tools.description: Registered tool names.

tools.name: quote_trade_get_challenge
tools.title: Quote.Trade get wallet auth challenge
tools.description: Optional wallet login/register step 1 (not required for trading with an existing API key). POST /api/getChallenge with a wallet address (login). Returns challenge text and isNewUser. Step 2: sign the challenge with the wallet outside MCP. Step 3: quote_trade_logon. No API key required.

login.description: Wallet address used as login, e.g. 0x15b65a49faf9a4047e912d7de4a77fe24c7cf483.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_logon
tools.title: Quote.Trade wallet logon / register
tools.description: Optional wallet login/register step 3 (not required if the agent already has an API key). Pass challenge + wallet signature from steps 1–2. isNewUser=true -> POST /api/registerUser; else POST /api/logon. On success, map body.requestToken/requestSecret to X-MBX-APIKEY / X-MBX-APISECRET; use body.id as account. For quote_trade_withdraw use body.walletRequestToken/walletRequestSecret as those headers instead. Wallet signing stays outside MCP.

challenge.description: Challenge text returned by quote_trade_get_challenge (Sign auth token: ...).

signature.description: Wallet signature of the challenge text (0x-prefixed hex).

isNewUser.description: From quote_trade_get_challenge. true -> registerUser; false -> logon. If omitted, logon is tried first then registerUser on failure.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

credentialMapping.description: Present on success only. Maps this response's requestToken/requestSecret (trading), walletRequestToken/walletRequestSecret (withdraw) and id to the MCP client headers and account field to use next.

nextStep.description: Present on success only. What to configure before calling private tools.

tools.name: quote_trade_get_deposit_address
tools.title: Quote.Trade get deposit address
tools.description: Deposit step 1. GET /api/getDepositAddress?symbol=ASSET and return chain + contract/address. Supported assets: USDC and USDT (mainnet), XUSDC (USDC on XDC). Step 2 is transferring funds to that address outside MCP (no backend call).

symbol.description: Deposit asset symbol: USDC or USDT (mainnet), or XUSDC (USDC on XDC network).

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_status
tools.title: Quote.Trade status
tools.description: Call GET /api/status and return system status, server time, contracts URL, and feature flags.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_exchange_info
tools.title: Quote.Trade exchange info
tools.description: Call GET /api/exchangeInfo and return a paginated slice of trading symbols plus rate limits/server time. Upstream has no pagination, so this adapter filters/slices locally. Default limit=50, max=200. Prefer quote_trade_instruments for compact tradable-pair discovery.

limit.description: Max symbols to return. Default 50, max 200.

skip.description: Number of matching symbols to skip before returning. Default 0.

symbols.description: Optional comma-separated symbol filter, e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL. When set, pagination applies to the filtered list.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_instruments
tools.title: Quote.Trade instruments
tools.description: Trade step 1. GET /api/getInstrumentPairs — paginated tradable symbols/instruments. Default limit=50, max=200. Use skip to page. Pick a symbol from this response for ticker/depth/order calls.

limit.description: Max instruments to return. Default 50, max 200.

skip.description: Number of instruments to skip before returning. Default 0.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_ticker
tools.title: Quote.Trade ticker
tools.description: Trade step 2. GET /api/ticker?symbol=SYMBOL for a symbol from quote_trade_instruments. Returns last price, bid, ask, lastUpdateId.

symbol.description: Instrument symbol from quote_trade_instruments, such as BTC or ETH.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_depth
tools.title: Quote.Trade order depth
tools.description: Trade step 3. GET /api/depth?symbol=SYMBOL&limit=N. Use depth quantity to choose a suitable limit price before placing an order.

symbol.description: Instrument symbol from quote_trade_instruments, such as BTC or ETH.

limit.description: Optional maximum levels per side. Positive values are enforced by MCP; omitted/nonpositive uses upstream depth.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_account
tools.title: Quote.Trade account summary
tools.description: Withdraw step 1 / anytime account check. GET /api/account with per-request X-MBX-APIKEY. Inspect available balances before withdraw. No live trading action.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_get_positions
tools.title: Quote.Trade current positions
tools.description: Anytime position check. GET /api/positions with per-request X-MBX-APIKEY. Reconcile current positions when starting or reconnecting, per the direct-discovery guide (quote_trade_api_discovery / rest.privateReads). No live trading action.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_get_orders
tools.title: Quote.Trade current/open orders
tools.description: Anytime order check. POST /api/getOrders with per-request X-MBX-APIKEY. Read-only: no live trading action. Requires read entitlement on API keys that carry one.

symbol.description: Optional instrument symbol filter, such as BTC. Omit for all symbols.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of orders to return.

startTime.description: Optional inclusive start of a time range, epoch milliseconds.

endTime.description: Optional inclusive end of a time range, epoch milliseconds.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_get_order_status
tools.title: Quote.Trade single order status
tools.description: Anytime order check. POST /api/orderStatus with per-request X-MBX-APIKEY. Query the status of an order previously placed with quote_trade_place_order. Read-only: no live trading action.

orderId.description: The order id returned by quote_trade_place_order.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_get_risk
tools.title: Quote.Trade account risk/margin summary
tools.description: Anytime risk check. POST /api/getRisk with per-request X-MBX-APIKEY. Margin/equity/unrealized-PnL summary for the authenticated account. Read-only: no live trading action.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_get_order_history
tools.title: Quote.Trade order history
tools.description: Anytime order check. POST /api/getOrderHistory with per-request X-MBX-APIKEY. Full order history, or one order's history with optional orderId. Requires a trade-scoped API key (same scope as quote_trade_place_order). Read-only: no live trading action.

orderId.description: Optional order id to narrow to one order's history. Omit for the full order history.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_get_deposit_history
tools.title: Quote.Trade deposit history
tools.description: Anytime deposit check. POST /api/getDepositHistory with per-request X-MBX-APIKEY. Requires a trade-scoped API key (same scope as quote_trade_place_order). Read-only: no live trading action.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_get_withdraw_requests
tools.title: Quote.Trade withdraw request history
tools.description: Anytime withdrawal check. POST /api/getWithdrawRequests with per-request X-MBX-APIKEY. Inspect the status of withdrawals already submitted (including via quote_trade_withdraw). Requires a trade-scoped API key. Read-only: no live trading action, and this tool cannot cancel a withdrawal.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_get_user_wallets
tools.title: Quote.Trade known deposit wallet addresses
tools.description: Anytime wallet check. POST /api/getUserWallets with per-request X-MBX-APIKEY. On-chain addresses previously seen depositing to the authenticated account. Read-only: no live trading action.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_get_index_positions
tools.title: Quote.Trade index/basket positions
tools.description: Anytime position check. POST /api/getIndexPositions with per-request X-MBX-APIKEY. Distinct from quote_trade_get_positions: index/basket instrument positions rather than regular instrument positions. Optional assetType filter. Read-only: no live trading action.

assetType.description: Optional index/basket asset type filter. Omit for all.

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_order_preview
tools.title: Quote.Trade order preview
tools.description: Optional before live trade. Normalize/validate a BUY/SELL order locally without sending it.

account.description: Quote.Trade account/user id. Optional for preview (defaults to account init-param, QUOTE_TRADE_ACCOUNT, or 0). Required for live place_order.

symbol.description: Instrument symbol from quote_trade_instruments, such as BTC.

disableLeverage.description: 1 disables leverage; 0 enables leverage/shorting only if server allowLeverage is true.

willSend.description: Whether this preview would send a live order.

estimatedNotional.description: Estimated notional in USD (orders: price×qty; withdraws: USD price×human quantity).

estimatedQuantity.description: Withdraw human quantity only (quantity / 10^quantity_scale). Present on withdraw previews.

estimatedNotionalUsd.description: Withdraw USD notional. Present on withdraw previews when priced.

priceUsd.description: USD unit price used for withdraw notional.

destination.description: Withdraw previews only: always own-wallet-login-only (no toAddress accepted).

notionalWarning.description: Withdraw previews only: present when a USD price could not be resolved.

withdrawAssetAllowed.description: Withdraw previews only: whether the asset passes allowedWithdrawAssets.

symbolAllowed.description: Whether the order symbol or withdrawal asset passes its own allowlist (empty=deny-all; *=all supported).

withinMaxNotional.description: Always true for a valid preview: MCP imposes no USD notional cap. This does not establish balance, margin or authorization.

credentialsPresent.description: Whether per-request trading credentials are present.

approvalFrictionOnly.description: True when approval fields are friction only.

requestBody.description: Normalized order request body that would be posted.

tools.name: quote_trade_place_order
tools.title: Quote.Trade place live order
tools.description: Trade step 4. POST /api/order with a suitable price after instruments/ticker/depth. Requires tradingEnabled, allowedSymbols (* or explicit list; empty denies), and API credentials. No MCP USD notional cap applies. Sending X-MBX-APISECRET to this MCP host grants it full signing authority. humanApproved/approvalText are agent friction only.

account.description: Quote.Trade account/user id. Optional for preview (defaults to account init-param, QUOTE_TRADE_ACCOUNT, or 0). Required for live place_order.

symbol.description: Instrument symbol from quote_trade_instruments, such as BTC.

disableLeverage.description: 1 disables leverage; 0 enables leverage/shorting only if server allowLeverage is true.

humanApproved.description: Agent-supplied confirmation friction (not a security control). Must be true; enableTrading remains authoritative.

approvalText.description: Agent-supplied confirmation friction (not a security control). Must exactly equal: APPROVE QUOTE.TRADE LIVE ORDER

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_cancel_order
tools.title: Quote.Trade cancel a single live order
tools.description: Cancel one order by orderId. POST /api/cancelOrder. Identifies exactly one order via the matching engine's single-order cancel path - NOT a mass-cancel. There is no quote_trade_cancel_all: the upstream mass-cancel action's scope for edge-case parameters could not be verified from this codebase alone and is intentionally not exposed through MCP. Requires tradingEnabled, allowedSymbols (same allowlist as quote_trade_place_order), and a trade-scoped API key. No notional check applies: a cancellation has none. humanApproved/approvalText are agent friction only.

account.description: Quote.Trade account/user id. Optional (defaults to account init-param, QUOTE_TRADE_ACCOUNT, or 0).

symbol.description: Instrument symbol the order was placed on, such as BTC.

orderId.description: The order id returned by quote_trade_place_order.

side.description: Optional BUY or SELL, matching the original order. Passed through if given.

humanApproved.description: Agent-supplied confirmation friction (not a security control). Must be true; enableTrading remains authoritative.

approvalText.description: Agent-supplied confirmation friction (not a security control). Must exactly equal: APPROVE QUOTE.TRADE CANCEL ORDER

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.

tools.name: quote_trade_withdraw_preview
tools.title: Quote.Trade withdraw preview
tools.description: Optional before live withdraw. Stablecoins only: USDC, USDT, or XUSDC (not BTC/ETH/other). Own login wallet only (no toAddress). estimatedNotional is USD at $1 peg. Trade-only API keys and the logon/register trade pair cannot withdraw — use the logon/register walletRequestToken/walletRequestSecret as X-MBX-APIKEY/X-MBX-APISECRET, or a created API key with the WITHDRAW permission.

account.description: Quote.Trade account/user id. Optional for preview (defaults to account init-param, QUOTE_TRADE_ACCOUNT, or 0). Required for live withdraw.

symbol.description: Stablecoin to withdraw: USDC, USDT, or XUSDC only (not BTC/ETH/other).

quantity.description: Scaled integer quantity as string (API format). Example: "20000000" with quantity_scale=6 means 20 USDC.

quantity_scale.description: Decimal scale for quantity; must equal the instrument's quantity scale. Example: 6 for USDC.

willSend.description: Whether this preview would send a live order.

estimatedNotional.description: Estimated notional in USD (orders: price×qty; withdraws: USD price×human quantity).

estimatedQuantity.description: Withdraw human quantity only (quantity / 10^quantity_scale). Present on withdraw previews.

estimatedNotionalUsd.description: Withdraw USD notional. Present on withdraw previews when priced.

priceUsd.description: USD unit price used for withdraw notional.

destination.description: Withdraw previews only: always own-wallet-login-only (no toAddress accepted).

notionalWarning.description: Withdraw previews only: present when a USD price could not be resolved.

withdrawAssetAllowed.description: Withdraw previews only: whether the asset passes allowedWithdrawAssets.

symbolAllowed.description: Whether the order symbol or withdrawal asset passes its own allowlist (empty=deny-all; *=all supported).

withinMaxNotional.description: Always true for a valid preview: MCP imposes no USD notional cap. This does not establish balance, margin or authorization.

credentialsPresent.description: Whether per-request trading credentials are present.

approvalFrictionOnly.description: True when approval fields are friction only.

requestBody.description: Normalized order request body that would be posted.

tools.name: quote_trade_withdraw
tools.title: Quote.Trade live withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw step 3. POST /api/sendWithdrawWithVTokenRequest for stablecoins only (USDC|USDT|XUSDC) to the user's own login wallet (no toAddress). Not available for BTC/ETH/other assets. Requires the logon/register walletRequestToken/walletRequestSecret as X-MBX-APIKEY/X-MBX-APISECRET, or a created API key with the WITHDRAW permission (trade-only keys and the logon/register trade pair are rejected by Quote.Trade), tradingEnabled, and allowedWithdrawAssets (independent of the trading allowedSymbols allowlist). No MCP USD notional cap applies. humanApproved/approvalText are agent friction only.

account.description: Quote.Trade account/user id. Optional for preview (defaults to account init-param, QUOTE_TRADE_ACCOUNT, or 0). Required for live withdraw.

symbol.description: Stablecoin to withdraw: USDC, USDT, or XUSDC only (not BTC/ETH/other).

quantity.description: Scaled integer quantity as string (API format). Example: "20000000" with quantity_scale=6 means 20 USDC.

quantity_scale.description: Decimal scale for quantity; must equal the instrument's quantity scale. Example: 6 for USDC.

humanApproved.description: Agent-supplied confirmation friction (not a security control). Must be true; enableTrading remains authoritative.

approvalText.description: Agent-supplied confirmation friction (not a security control). Must exactly equal: APPROVE QUOTE.TRADE LIVE WITHDRAW

body.description: Parsed JSON response body when valid JSON; otherwise the raw text.
